headline: Trump 🍊👨‍💼 COLD-BITCH SLAPPED 🥶👋 by Own Besties 🤝
text:
TRUMP 🍊👑 used to bending DC like a BAD BENDY STRAW 🥤💥 just got served ICE-COLD REALITY 🧊😤 from his OWN inner circle! Two BRUTAL losses 💥💥 in DAYS, and even the Orange Emperor 👑😩 can't tweet his way out this time! 

First up: Reflecting Pool DRAMA 💦🏛️ - Trump went full KAREN mode 😡💅 screaming 'VANDALISM! ARREST EVERYONE! 🔨🚨' but his handpicked US Attorney Jeanine Pirro 🍷🦊 folded FASTER than a CHEAP UMBRELLA ☂️💨. 'Botched repairs' she said, 'NOT vandalism' - BOOM 💥 reality check! Trump went full meltdown on Truth Social 📱😤: 'SHE FOLDED LIKE AN UMBRELLA! ☂️💔' - Jeanine just couldn't defend his ALTERNATIVE FACTS 🤡📜 in court, so she bailed! 

Then came the Attorney General drama: Todd Blanche 🧑‍⚖️💼 Trump's former criminal defense lawyer turned AG nominee got BLOCKED 🚫 by his OWN Republican senators! John Cornyn 🤠 and Thom Tillis 🧔 demanded he KILL the $1.8BN 'anti-weaponisation fund' 💰🛑 - Tillis called it a 'PAYOUT POT FOR PUNKS' 🎭💸! Blanche had to write TWO LETTERS 📜📜 disavowing the fund before the Senate would even look at him! Trump claimed he 'didn't look at' the docs 👀🚫 but said Blanche will 'do a GREAT JOB' - classic boss move! 

But the REAL tea ☕☕ is the Iran war situation: Trump keeps flip-flopping like a FISH 🐟💨 between 'I called off WW3! 🛑💥' and 'Iran is LYING! 🤥🇮🇷' while polls show his approval rating TANKING 📉 to 33% - worse than Nixon post-Watergate! 😱📉 Trump claims his 'REAL polls' are the BEST EVER 🏆 but American voters are like 'nah fam' 👎🗳️! 

Three months till midterms and even Trump's most loyal allies are telling him the cold, hard truth: reality doesn't bend to alternative facts, and his political fate might just depend on facing it! 🥶📊
